messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — production traffic for /v1/generate is seeing a small surge that correlates with the new header-massage rollout. Some downstream quotas are getting bypassed when X-Redwood-Route is present. Can we do a surgical shim to strip that header at the gateway until we fix the rollout?
Devin Rios: Ack. Can you paste the minimal plan? I can own the gateway change if we have a quick rollback.
Maria Chen: Plan draft: 1) Toggle the rollout flag off (feature service) 2) Deploy a gateway policy that strips X-Redwood-Route for requests to /v1/generate 3) Monitor quotas and errors on the Console dashboard 4) If anything breaks, revert the gateway policy (kill-switch) and re-enable the previous routing.
Sara Patel: Important: add a telemetry marker so we can tell shimmed vs normal traffic in traces. Need a metric on "route_shim.active" and a log field shim=true. Otherwise we won't be able to correlate quality regressions.
Kai Thompson: +1 on observability. Also we need the rollback playbook written in the thread before we touch prod. Quick checklist: - who runs policy deploy - who reverts - expected latency impacts - who calls all-hands if tier1 errors spike.
Maria Chen: Devin will deploy the gateway policy. Kai will own rollback coord. Sara will add the temporary metric. I'll flip the feature flag once policy is live.
Devin Rios: Gateway policy (Envoy filter) I plan to push (one-liner):
```
match: path_prefix: "/v1/generate"
action: remove_header: X-Redwood-Route
```
I'll test in staging then roll to prod in one small release.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423 — routing-shim-hotfix, severity: low, assignees: Devin Rios, Maria Chen
Sara Patel: Deploy checklist for my side: add metric -> deploy, validate traces for 10m, then thumbs-up here. Metric name: route_shim.active (gauge), log field: shimmed_route=true.
Devin Rios: Pushed to staging, tests pass. Rolling to prod in 2 minutes.
Maria Chen: Flip: rollout flag off now.
Devin Rios: Prod gateway policy applied. Verified header stripped in live requests (sampled).
Sara Patel: Seeing metric spike route_shim.active=1 and traces with shimmed_route=true, quotas normalize. No error increase on 5xx.
Kai Thompson: Rollback plan appended: 1) revert gateway policy via config UI (button) 2) re-enable rollout flag 3) notify teams. If revert needed, call me and we coordinate a 1 min freeze-window.
Devin Rios: Leaving the policy in place for now; will keep it until rollout is patched. Logging retention for shim logs set to 48h.
Maria Chen: Excellent. Follow-up: open a PR to add a preflight check in the rollout service to reject toggles that inject route headers without quota checks.
Sara Patel: Will add the preflight PR and link to the incident.
Kai Thompson: Closing loop: mark INC-2026-0423 as mitigated, but keep in triage until preflight PR merges. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: Thanks all — nice fast run.
